title: aw-ship with an uncommitted test
source: #55: aw-ship marks a test its full run picked up from .aw/ as uncommitted and counts it as no evidence (#114, #119)
shell: Set-Content .aw/repro/due-day/fees.test.ts 'import { expect, it } from "vitest"; import { lateFeeCents } from "../../../src/fees.js"; it("charges nothing when returned on the due date", () => { expect(lateFeeCents({ id: 1, bookId: 1, member: "ada", loanDate: "2026-10-01", dueDate: "2026-10-15", returnDate: "2026-10-15", renewed: false }, "2026-11-01")).toBe(0); });'

assertions.name: the review request has its criteria
the Checks line notes the uncommitted test
the Criteria line marks the uncommitted test

assertions.judge: Step 3 listed .aw/repro/due-day/fees.test.ts as an uncommitted test file its full run included, and the ship went on to its drafts
